verdict.rationale: Typesense documents built-in high availability with automatic Raft leader election in the open-source server, a Cloud HA option, dedicated clusters with no record limits, and auto scaling, plus Kubernetes, Docker Swarm and Terraform deployment paths. However, nothing shows horizontal sharding or a path to hundreds of millions of documents; the largest showcased dataset is 32M songs, and community commenters say the in-memory, non-sharded design caps index size. missing for 10: documented sharding/horizontal partitioning, detailed clustering/replication setup docs, evidence of hundreds-of-millions-document deployments, independent hands-on scale corroboration.
